research.notes: Not publishable: fiscal sponsor conflict. The agenda names Global Impact (Alexandria, VA) as fiscal sponsor, but public pages (EdSource, Early Edge California, Education First) call EBC a sponsored project of New Venture Fund. The legal payee in the agenda is likely the fiscal sponsor, whose identity could not be confirmed. Global Impact (EIN 52-1273585, Washington DC per charity.org) was not matched to EBC on any public page. Registry IDs and addresses deliberately omitted.

profile.summary: The Emerging Bilingual Collaborative is a group of funders that invests in California's education system so young multilingual learners in preschool through third grade have access to culturally affirming, rich instruction that builds reading and writing skills in both their home language and English. It funds grantee organizations and supports work on narrative change, state policy, regional coordination and local learning environments.
